answer: A workable design: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The network ties the nectar to sunk effort, uses the terrace as an corroborating signal, then requires a vertex before any payout.
